intro: A plain love song from Time Out of Mind that other singers took up almost at once. Billy Joel released it before Dylan's own album came out.

lives.title: Time Out of Mind
lives.note: Recorded with Daniel Lanois producing, Dylan on piano. On Time Out of Mind, September 1997.

lives.title: Billy Joel goes first
lives.note: Released as "To Make You Feel My Love" a month before Dylan's album.

lives.title: First performance
lives.note: Added to the shows within weeks of the album.

lives.title: Garth Brooks
lives.note: A number one on the US country chart.

lives.title: Adele
lives.note: Her piano version became a UK top five hit in 2010.
